modelOverview: Launched in 1993 as Audemars Piguet's larger, more aggressive take on the Royal Oak, the Offshore chronograph line pairs the octagonal bezel and integrated bracelet/strap of the original with a bolder case, exposed screws and a flyback chronograph movement. Over three decades it has been produced across titanium, steel, ceramic and precious-metal executions, spanning roughly 42-44mm case sizes, and remains AP's flagship muscular sports chronograph. All examples below are sourced and authenticated prior to sale.

26420TI.OO.A027CA.01.materials: Titanium case, sandblasted titanium pushpiece guards, black ceramic pushpieces and screw-locked crown, interchangeable rubber strap
26420TI.OO.A027CA.01.bezel: Titanium octagonal bezel with exposed screws
26420TI.OO.A027CA.01.dial: Blue "Méga Tapisserie" dial with white-gold hour markers, small seconds at 6 and date at 4:30
26420TI.OO.A027CA.01.description: The 26420TI is AP's all-titanium Royal Oak Offshore Chronograph in 43mm, running the in-house flyback Calibre 4401 with a 70-hour reserve. Its vivid blue Méga Tapisserie dial against a light, sandblasted titanium case is one of the more distinctive combinations in the modern Offshore line-up. This example is sourced and authenticated.

variants.Grey – Titanium: 26420TI reference finished in its signature sandblasted titanium case (giving the watch its grey, tool-watch tone) paired with the blue Méga Tapisserie dial and interchangeable blue/black rubber straps; 43mm, Calibre 4401 flyback chronograph.

26400IO.OO.A004CA.01.materials: Titanium case, black ceramic bezel, titanium pin buckle, grey rubber strap
26400IO.OO.A004CA.01.bezel: Black ceramic octagonal bezel with exposed screws
26400IO.OO.A004CA.01.dial: Slate-grey "Méga Tapisserie" dial with a blue inner bezel ring, rhodium sub-dials, luminescent index hour markers and date window
26400IO.OO.A004CA.01.description: The 26400IO couples a 44mm titanium case with a black ceramic bezel, one of the more understated Offshore chronograph combinations, run by the self-winding Calibre 3126/3840 with a 50-hour reserve. The slate-grey dial's blue inner bezel ring gives this reference its distinguishing accent colour. Sourced and authenticated.

variants.Blue – Titanium: 26400IO.OO.A004CA.01 in titanium and black ceramic, distinguished by the blue inner bezel ring set against the slate-grey Méga Tapisserie dial; 44mm case, Calibre 3126/3840, 50h power reserve.

26420ST.OO.A002CA.01.materials: Stainless steel case, black ceramic bezel, pushpieces and screw-locked crown, sandblasted steel pushpiece guards, interchangeable rubber/calfskin strap
26420ST.OO.A002CA.01.bezel: Black ceramic octagonal bezel with exposed screws
26420ST.OO.A002CA.01.dial: Black "Méga Tapisserie" dial with rhodium-toned counters, white-gold applied hour markers and luminescent Royal Oak hands
26420ST.OO.A002CA.01.description: A steel-and-black-ceramic Royal Oak Offshore Chronograph in 43mm powered by AP's in-house flyback Calibre 4401, pairing the classic black Méga Tapisserie dial with a black ceramic bezel and pushers. This is the modern-generation steel/ceramic reference in AP's current Offshore chronograph catalogue. Sourced and authenticated; note that the closely-related reference commonly documented for this exact steel/ceramic/black-dial specification is catalogued by AP as 26420SO.OO.A002CA.01, so the precise suffix on individual pieces should be confirmed against the watch and papers.

variants.Black – Steel: Steel case with black ceramic bezel and black Méga Tapisserie dial, 43mm, Calibre 4401 flyback chronograph, 70h power reserve.

26470OR.OO.1000OR.01.bezel: 18k rose gold octagonal bezel with 8 exposed screws
26470OR.OO.1000OR.01.dial: Pink-gold-toned "Méga Tapisserie" dial with black chronograph counters and black Arabic numerals with luminescent coating
26470OR.OO.1000OR.01.description: Introduced at SIHH 2014, the 26470OR is a full rose-gold Royal Oak Offshore Chronograph on integrated rose-gold bracelet, 42mm, running the self-winding Calibre 3126/3840 with a 50-hour reserve. Its warm pink-gold dial and case give it the deep, brown-toned look prized in this all-gold reference. Sourced and authenticated.

variants.Brown – Rose Gold: Full 18k rose gold execution on integrated rose gold bracelet with a pink-gold-toned dial reading warm brown/bronze in most lighting; 42mm case, Calibre 3126/3840, 50h power reserve.

26420CE.OO.A002CA.01.materials: Black ceramic case, titanium pushpiece guards and links, interchangeable rubber strap
26420CE.OO.A002CA.01.bezel: Black ceramic octagonal bezel with exposed screws
26420CE.OO.A002CA.01.dial: Black "Méga Tapisserie" dial with black counters and external zone, applied hour markers and luminescent Royal Oak hands
26420CE.OO.A002CA.01.description: A full black-ceramic Royal Oak Offshore Chronograph in 43mm, using AP's in-house flyback Calibre 4401 with a 70-hour reserve, for a monochrome, all-black case-and-dial execution typical of the modern ceramic Offshore chronographs. Sourced and authenticated; the exact suffix of this particular ceramic reference should be cross-checked against the watch's case-back markings and accompanying papers, as AP's black-ceramic Offshore chronographs are catalogued under several closely related reference suffixes (e.g. 26420CE.OO.A063VE.01, 26420CE.OO.A043VE.01).

variants.Black Ceramic: All-black ceramic case and bezel with black Méga Tapisserie dial; 43mm, Calibre 4401 flyback chronograph, 70h power reserve.
